notes:
v0.6.35: fix ReticulumHF launcher link (:8080 → :80) + bootstrap creates .setup_complete.

Two bugs on a fresh image:

1. The launcher's "ReticulumHF" link at the bottom of the page
   pointed to http://<host>:8080/status — but :8080 is not
   listening on a fresh reticulumpi. Only :80 has the wizard.
   Clicking the link was a silent no-op.

2. freedvtnc2.service has ConditionPathExists=!/etc/reticulumhf/
   .setup_complete — without that file, the unit is always
   skipped with "unmet condition check" (Sep 09 15:23 on the
   fresh build). The ReticulumHF wizard creates the file when
   its setup flow finishes, but the bootstrap never runs the
   wizard, so even with the right AUDIO_CARD, freedvtnc2.service
   never started.

Fix:
- Launcher template: ReticulumHF link :8080/status → :80/
  (the wizard's setup page). One-way relationship:
  launcher → wizard, not the reverse. The wizard ends
  setup with `window.location.href = '/status'` which goes
  to the wizard's own status page on :80, not the launcher.
- Bootstrap: `sudo touch /etc/reticulumhf/.setup_complete`
  after copying config.env. The flag file lets freedvtnc2
  start using the bootstrap's defaults. Operator can delete
  the file to re-run the wizard:
    sudo rm /etc/reticulumhf/.setup_complete

Effect: clicking the ReticulumHF link now opens the wizard
where the operator can re-pick their radio (which sets
AUDIO_CARD correctly). After wizard completion, freedvtnc2
service starts. Without the wizard, freedvtnc2 also starts
using the bootstrap's defaults.
